title: Susan McCasland accepted a calendar invite for a DeLonge-Podesta meeting

tellings.quote: a calendar notification shows that Susan herself accepted a Google calendar invite for something called a Dong Podesta meeting.

plain: A woman named Susan McCasland is said to have accepted a Google calendar invite for a meeting between the rock musician Tom DeLonge and John Podesta, a senior Washington political adviser, around 2015 or 2016. Michels points to this himself, citing the Podesta emails, messages from Podesta's account that were published by WikiLeaks, a website that releases leaked documents, where he says "a calendar notification shows that Susan herself accepted a Google calendar invite for something called a Dong Podesta meeting." He raises it as a sign that the McCasland household was tied into DeLonge's private push to get officials talking about UFOs.
